verdict.rationale: The docs show that cfo.ai is operated through its Ari assistant in natural language. You can ask whether you can afford a hire or how long cash lasts, have Ari rebuild a workbook, request scenarios in one line, or ask it to sync another table. External agents such as Claude Code and Codex can also drive Ari chats and edit the Model through the MCP server, and every write is undoable. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably in practice.
